required_nodes.rationale: Proves the frozen field, embedding, digest, loader, and exact-byte round-trip compatibility with the current actuator.
Proves deterministic inert intent preparation and zero request or installation-state writes.
Proves fixed paths, authenticated locking, one-generation create-only custody, receipt-last publication, and fail-closed partial custody.
Proves exact trusted inputs, cryptographic/currentness chains, byte fidelity, absent signing/root authority, and one verification instant.
Proves registrar compatibility in an isolated catalog without canonical registration, grant, runtime authority, effect, or mutation.
Proves the exact unregistered five-effect candidate, reproducible digest, bundle-authority distinction, and unchanged canonical catalog.
